about: The short/prose boundary the release-check laya-auto row depends on (engine#3355): a request that asks for an explanation, summary or piece of writing is prose even when it asks for only a sentence or two, while short is a one-line lookup (a word, number, name, date, definition, translation or greeting). The three release-check probes are here too, so a wording or checkpoint change that moves one of them is caught by name.

cases.text: Summarise what tides are and why they happen, in two sentences.
Summarise the causes of inflation in one sentence.
Describe how rainbows form, in two sentences.
Write two sentences about why the sky is blue.
What is the boiling point of water in Fahrenheit?
Write a Python function that reverses a linked list.
